title: General Requirements
author: 640e03081170df1b3696850b
chapter_outcomes: Choose a global issue that is important, interesting, and divides opinion
Formulate a clear and focused global research question
Conduct initial research to explore the context of a topic and its global issue
Investigate a range of perspectives on the global issue, including local, national, and global viewpoints
Analyse the reasoning, arguments, and claims behind different perspectives
Understand why different people, groups, or nations hold different perspectives
Examine causes, consequences, and impacts of the global issue
Evaluate possible courses of action and propose a justified solution
Present a structured, coherent report with clear argumentation and evidence
Use sources effectively, citing all material and evaluating their reliability and credibility
Reflect on research findings, personal learning, and others’ perspectives
Communicate ideas clearly and effectively in a formal essay format
Draw reasoned conclusions that answer the research question
